title: Aniccena (2)
text: 1-2 Sāvatthi || || Yam bhikkhave aniccam tatra vo rāgo pahātabbo || || Kiñca bhikkhave aniccaṃ || || 3 Rūpam bhikkhave aniccaṃ tatra vo rāgo pahātabbo || || 4-7 Vedanā || || Saññā || || {Saṅkhārā} || || Viññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ || tatra vo rāgo pahātabbo || || 8 Yam bhikkhave aniccaṃ tatra vo rāgo pahātabbo ti || ||
